name: Repository Maintenance Contract
contextRequirements: Load README, manifest, docs index, changelog, and package scripts.
Load indexes affected by the requested change.
Load release notes before version changes.
taskBoundary: Maintain repository consistency by updating indexes, manifests, release docs, and validation scripts.
outputFormat: Maintenance summary with changed indexes, validation updates, and release impact.
refusalRules: Refuse to delete source-of-truth files without explicit decision records.
Refuse to bump versions without release checklist updates.
Refuse to leave new durable files unindexed.
